```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)

# control all graphs here! std stat choices: theta_pi, theta_w, tajimas_d, fay_wus_h, zengs_e, pbs, nss
statistic <<- "pbs"
```

```{r}
paths <- c("1.6kb" = "check_1.6kb.txt",
           "8kb"   = "check_8kb.txt",
           "40kb"  = "check_40kb.txt",
           "200kb" = "check_200kb.txt")

widths <- c("1.6kb" = 1600, "8kb" = 8000, "40kb" = 40000, "200kb" = 200000)
fracs  <- c("1.6kb" = 0.2, "8kb" = 1, "40kb" = 1, "200kb" = 1)

winstats <- imap_dfr(paths, function(p, sz) {
  read_delim(p, col_types = cols(.default = col_double())) %>%
    filter(win_start != "win_start") %>%
    filter(.data[[statistic]] != -998, !is.na(.data[[statistic]])) %>%
    sample_frac(fracs[[sz]]) %>%
    mutate(size = sz, w = widths[[sz]] * 0.8)
}) %>%
  mutate(size = factor(size, levels = names(paths)),
         win_start = as.numeric(win_start))

ggplot(winstats, aes(win_start, .data[[statistic]], group = win_start)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(width = w), outlier.size = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ size, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_light() +
  labs(title = paste(statistic, "across window sizes"),
       x = "window start", y = paste(statistic, "value"))

# ggsave("window_size_opt_pbs.png", width = 15, height = 10, dpi = 300, units = "in")
```
